result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and gave sensible output. I checked each answer by eye against the sample rows. I didn't test edge cases such as ties or stray whitespace in the text files.

H1: /data | filter ~(and (/active | eq true) (at :address | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(at :city | type | eq ::string))) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
H2: filter ~(/status | if (type | eq ::string) ~(lower | eq "paid") ~(false)) * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
H3: :d /devDependencies | /dependencies | union d | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | keys | sort * (:k / | keyword | append "@" | append (m | at k))
H4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(/login)) | groupBy ~(/) * count
H5: :d /defaults | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | ne false) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d | /timeout)) :retries (coalesce ~(/retries) ~(d | /retries))} | sort ~/name
H6: filter ~(at :durationMs | ne null) | groupBy ~/service * ([(* /durationMs | sum) count] | :p / | /0 | div (p | /1) | round 1)
H7: filter ~(at :stock | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gt 0) ~(false)) | sort ~/price | reverse | take 3 * /name
H8: groupBy ~/dept * (* (at :skills | coalesce ~(/) ~([])) | flat * lower | distinct | sort)
H9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~(and (/region | eq "eu-west") (at :cpu | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(at :cores | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gte 8) ~(false))))
H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split ";" * (split ",") | flat * (split "@" | last | lower | split " " | first) | distinct | sort
H11: lines | filter ~(split " " | /3 | parseJson | gte 500) * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) * count | :m / | keys * (:k / | keyword | {:path / :count (m | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /path]) | take 2
H12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(split "," | /2 | ne "") * (split ",") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | [sum count] | :p / | /0 | div (p | /1) | round 2)
H13: lines | filter ~(contains "==") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "==") | indexBy ~(/0 | lower) * /1
H14: sort ~(at :comments | coalesce ~(/) ~([]) | * (at :likes | coalesce ~(/) ~(0)) | sum) | last | /title
